prompt: Compose an email asking a former teammate whether they would be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with a newcomer to the group. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: A few tips for someone new to the team?

Hi [Name],

I hope you’ve been doing well! A new colleague, [Newcomer’s Name], recently joined [Group], and I thought of you as someone who could offer a helpful perspective on getting settled.

Would you be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with them? Things like navigating team routines, finding useful resources, or knowing whom to ask for help could make their first few weeks easier. There’s no need to prepare anything formal—a short email or a quick chat, whichever you’d prefer, would be wonderful.

No pressure at all if your schedule is full. If you’re open to it, I’d be happy to introduce you.

Thanks for considering it!

Best,
[Your Name]
